result.brief: 提出DiVid维度级多样性诊断框架，将视频生成多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动、相机六维，揭示运动与相机维度的多样性塌缩及可控性瓶颈。
result.reason: Diagnostic framework for dimension-specific diversity collapse in video generation, covering motion and camera controllability, directly serving video generation evaluation and controllable generation.
